title: Memos: Notion but private — run it yourself.  #github

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: a GitHub project a day. Today's project is Memos. If you want a note-taking tool that's fast, private, and fully yours, meet memos. It's an open- source self-hosted note app with zero ads, zero telemetry, and zero subscriptions. Markdown support, responsive UI, beautiful dark mode, and API access for developers. You get your notes on your server, your rules, oneline Docker install, blazing fast go backend, and export anytime. No lock in ever.
